blocks.content: 4. billing_mode: A Real, Practical Choice
billing_mode chooses between PROVISIONED, real, fixed capacity, and PAY_PER_REQUEST, genuinely scaling automatically with real, actual, live usage.

PROVISIONED becomes more real, cost-effective at genuinely high, predictable, real, sustained traffic levels, worth revisiting as real usage patterns become clearer.
This is a real, practical decision worth starting simple with, and revisiting deliberately as a project's real, actual needs genuinely become clearer.
